verses.t: By the dawn
verses.pickthall: By the Dawn
verses.yusufAli: By the break of Day
verses.rodwell: By the DAYBREAK
verses.sale: By the day-break

verses.t: And [by] ten nights
verses.pickthall: And ten nights
verses.yusufAli: By the Nights twice five
verses.rodwell: and ten nights
verses.sale: and then nights

verses.t: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
verses.pickthall: And the Even and the Odd
verses.yusufAli: By the even and odd (contrasted)
verses.rodwell: By that which is double and that which is single
verses.sale: by that which is double, and that which is single

verses.t: And [by] the night when it passes
verses.pickthall: And the night when it departeth
verses.yusufAli: And by the Night when it passeth away
verses.rodwell: By the night when it pursues its course
verses.sale: and by the night when it cometh on

verses.t: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception
verses.pickthall: There surely is an oath for thinking man
verses.yusufAli: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand
verses.rodwell: Is there not in this an oath becoming a man of sense
verses.sale: Is there not in this an oath formed with understanding

verses.t: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad
verses.pickthall: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad
verses.yusufAli: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people)
verses.rodwell: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with Ad
verses.sale: Hast thou not considered how thy Lord dealt with Ad

verses.t: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars
verses.pickthall: With many-columned Iram
verses.yusufAli: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars
verses.rodwell: At Irem adorned with pillars
verses.sale: the people of Irem, adorned with lofty buildings

verses.t: The likes of whom had never been created in the land
verses.pickthall: The like of which was not created in the lands
verses.yusufAli: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land
verses.rodwell: Whose like have not been reared in these lands
verses.sale: the like whereof hath not been erected in the land

verses.t: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley
verses.pickthall: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley
verses.yusufAli: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley
verses.rodwell: And with Themoud who hewed out the rocks in the valley
verses.sale: and with Thamud, who hewed the rocks in the valley into houses

verses.t: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes
verses.pickthall: And with Pharaoh, firm of might
verses.yusufAli: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes
verses.rodwell: And with Pharaoh the impaler
verses.sale: and with Pharaoh, the contriver of the stakes

verses.t: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
verses.pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands
verses.yusufAli: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands
verses.rodwell: Who all committed excesses in the lands
verses.sale: Who had behaved insolently in the earth

verses.t: And increased therein the corruption
verses.pickthall: And multiplied iniquity therein
verses.yusufAli: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief)
verses.rodwell: And multiplied wickedness therein
verses.sale: and multiplied corruption therein

verses.t: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment
verses.pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment
verses.yusufAli: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements
verses.rodwell: Wherefore thy Lord let loose on them the scourge of chastisement
verses.sale: Wherefore thy Lord poured on them various kinds of chastisement

verses.t: Indeed, your Lord is in observation
verses.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful
verses.yusufAli: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower
verses.rodwell: For thy Lord standeth on a watch tower
verses.sale: For thy Lord is surely in a watch-tower, whence He observeth the actions of men

verses.t: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me
verses.pickthall: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me
verses.yusufAli: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me
verses.rodwell: As to man, when his Lord trieth him and honoureth him and is bounteous to him, Then saith he, "My Lord honoureth me
verses.sale: Moreover man, when his Lord trieth him by prosperity, and honoureth him, and is bounteous unto him, saith, my Lord honoureth me

verses.t: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me
verses.pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me
verses.yusufAli: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me
verses.rodwell: But when he proveth him and limiteth his gifts to him, He saith, "My Lord despiseth me
verses.sale: But when He proveth him by afflictions, and withholdeth his provisions from him, he saith, my Lord despiseth me

verses.t: No! But you do not honor the orphan
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
verses.yusufAli: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans
verses.rodwell: Aye. But ye honour not the orphan
verses.sale: By no means: But ye honour not the orphan

verses.t: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor
verses.pickthall: And urge not on the feeding of the poor
verses.yusufAli: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor
verses.rodwell: Nor urge ye one another to feed the poor
verses.sale: neither do ye excite one another to feed the poor

verses.t: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether
verses.pickthall: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed
verses.yusufAli: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed
verses.rodwell: And ye devour heritages, devouring greedily
verses.sale: and ye devour the inheritance of the weak, with undistinguishing greediness

verses.t: And you love wealth with immense love
verses.pickthall: And love wealth with abounding love
verses.yusufAli: And ye love wealth with inordinate love
verses.rodwell: And ye love riches with exceeding love
verses.sale: and ye love riches, with much affection

verses.t: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
verses.pickthall: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding
verses.yusufAli: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder
verses.rodwell: Aye. But when the earth shall be crushed with crushing, crushing
verses.sale: By no means should ye do thus. When the earth shall be minutely ground to dust

verses.t: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank
verses.pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank
verses.yusufAli: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank
verses.rodwell: And thy Lord shall come and the angels rank on rank
verses.sale: and thy Lord shall come, and the angels rank by rank

verses.t: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance
verses.pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)
verses.yusufAli: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him
verses.rodwell: And Hell on that day shall be moved up, - Man shall on that day remember himself. But how shall remembrance help him
verses.sale: and hell, on that day, shall be brought nigh: On that day shall man call to remembrance his evil deeds; but how shall remembrance avail him

verses.t: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life
verses.pickthall: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life
verses.yusufAli: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life
verses.rodwell: He shall say, Oh! would that I had prepared for this my life
verses.sale: He shall say, would to God that I had heretofore done good works in my life-time

verses.t: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment
verses.pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day
verses.yusufAli: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict
verses.rodwell: On that day none shall punish as God punisheth
verses.sale: On that day none shall punish with his punishment

verses.t: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers]
verses.pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind
verses.yusufAli: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind
verses.rodwell: And none shall bind with such bonds as He
verses.sale: nor shall any bind with his bonds

verses.t: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul
verses.pickthall: But ah! thou soul at peace
verses.yusufAli: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction
verses.rodwell: Oh, thou soul which art at rest
verses.sale: O thou soul which art at rest

verses.t: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him]
verses.pickthall: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure
verses.yusufAli: Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him
verses.rodwell: Return to thy Lord, pleased, and pleasing him
verses.sale: return unto thy Lord, well pleased with thy reward, and well pleasing unto God

verses.t: And enter among My [righteous] servants
verses.pickthall: Enter thou among My bondmen
verses.yusufAli: Enter thou, then, among My devotees
verses.rodwell: Enter thou among my servants
verses.sale: Enter among my servants

verses.t: And enter My Paradise
verses.pickthall: Enter thou My Garden
verses.yusufAli: Yea, enter thou My Heaven
verses.rodwell: And enter thou my Paradise
verses.sale: and enter my paradise
